messages.subject: problem installing RSNNS package
messages.body_plain:
Hello Sir/Madam,

I am trying to install the RSNNS package on my Dell PC on WIndows. But I am getting this error message

> install.packages("RSNNS")
Warning: unable to access index for repository https://cran.rstudio.com/src/contrib:
  cannot open URL 'https://cran.rstudio.com/src/contrib/PACKAGES'
Warning in install.packages :
  unable to access index for repository https://cran.rstudio.com/src/contrib:
  cannot open URL 'https://cran.rstudio.com/src/contrib/PACKAGES'
Warning in install.packages :
  unable to access index for repository https://cran.rstudio.com/src/contrib:
  cannot open URL 'https://cran.rstudio.com/src/contrib/PACKAGES'
Warning in install.packages :
  package ‘RSNNS’ is not available (for R version 3.5.1)
Warning in install.packages :
  unable to access index for repository https://cran.rstudio.com/bin/windows/contrib/3.5:
  cannot open URL 'https://cran.rstudio.com/bin/windows/contrib/3.5/PACKAGES'

I need it for my Ph.D research work. Please kindly help.

Regards,
Anita H.Kenchannavar
